# Prototype kit, pinned copy

An unmodified copy of `imperialfox/prototype-kit` **1.1.0** (commit `3e7e119`, 2 Nov 2026), used only by the demo page for its device frame, controls panel and notes. It is never part of what an app loads.

| File | sha256 |
|---|---|
| `kit.css` | `962212d7dd27d814ee0c4a126aba479c7a56e15f375e9aabc6660f71a5c563ef` |
| `kit.js` | `c2ec58804d69a7367fcec68008ed0d362076a47c2ee47c7ae34ada60b2931c71` |

`tools/check.py` fails if either file changes. To move to a newer prototype kit, copy its release in and update this table.
